name: Determinar cuando un cliente podria alquilar un auto (Caso 1)
untr_name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 1)
description: Construya un programa que determine si un cliente puede alquilar un auto en base a las entradas que recibe del agente de alquiler de autos. Los autos de alquiler estan disponibles para conductores con licencia de 21 anos o mas.
untr_description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers of 21 years of age or over.

comments.content: Cerrar el objeto Scanner es importante para liberar los recursos que utiliza. Cuando llama `scan.close()`, esta indicando que termino de usar el Scanner, lo cual es una buena practica para evitar fugas de recursos.
comments.untr_content: Closing the Scanner object is important to free up the resources it uses. When you call `scan.close()`, you are telling the program that you are done using the Scanner object, which is a good practice to prevent resource leaks.

comments.content: La sintaxis `scan.close();` es directa: `scan` es el nombre de la variable del objeto Scanner, y `close()` es un metodo que pertenece a la clase Scanner. El punto y coma `;` se usa para terminar la sentencia.
comments.untr_content: The syntax `scan.close();` is straightforward: `scan` is the variable name of the Scanner object, and `close()` is a method that belongs to the Scanner class. The semicolon `;` is used to terminate the statement.

comments.content: Una idea equivocada es creer que cerrar el Scanner es opcional. Aunque el programa puede ejecutarse sin cerrarlo, no hacerlo puede conducir a fugas de recursos, especialmente en aplicaciones mas grandes.
comments.untr_content: A common misconception is that closing the Scanner is optional. While the program may run without closing it, not doing so can lead to resource leaks, especially in larger applications.

comments.content: Es una buena practica cerrar cualquier recurso de E/S como Scanner cuando ya no se necesita. Esto forma parte de la gestion efectiva de recursos en programacion Java.
comments.untr_content: It's a best practice to close any I/O resources like Scanner when they are no longer needed. This is part of effective resource management in Java programming.

comments.content: Esta linea declara e inicializa una variable booleana llamada 'canRentCar'. El proposito de esta linea es determinar si el cliente cumple los criterios para alquilar un auto: tener al menos 21 anos y poseer licencia de conducir.
comments.untr_content: This line declares and initializes a boolean variable named 'canRentCar'. The purpose of this line is to determine if the customer meets the criteria to rent a car, which is being at least 21 years old and having a driver's license.

comments.content: La expresion 'age >= 21 && hasLicense' es una expresion booleana que evalua a true si se cumplen ambas condiciones: la edad del cliente es 21 o mayor, y tiene licencia de conducir. El operador '&&' es un operador logico AND, lo que significa que ambas condiciones deben ser verdaderas para que la expresion completa sea true.
comments.untr_content: The expression 'age >= 21 && hasLicense' is a boolean expression that evaluates to true if both conditions are met: the customer's age is 21 or older, and they have a driver's license. The '&&' operator is a logical AND operator, which means both conditions must be true for the entire expression to be true.

comments.content: Una idea equivocada comun es entender mal el uso del operador '&&'. Recuerde que '&&' requiere que ambas condiciones sean verdaderas, a diferencia del operador '||', que requiere solo que una condicion sea verdadera.
comments.untr_content: A common misconception might be misunderstanding the use of the '&&' operator. Remember, '&&' requires both conditions to be true, unlike the '||' operator, which requires only one condition to be true.

distractors.description: Podria escoger esta linea si equivocadamente cree que un cliente debe ser mayor de 21 anos, en lugar de 21 o mayor, para alquilar un auto. Esta confucion surge a menudo de la diferencia entre los operadores 'mayor que' (>) y 'mayor o igual que' (>=). Usar este distractor impediria incorrectamente que los clientes de 21 anos alquilen un auto, ya que la condicion solo seria verdadera para quienes tengan 22 anos o mas. Este error resalta la importancia de entender las diferencias sutiles entre los operadores de comparacion.
distractors.untr_description: You might choose this line if you mistakenly believe that a customer must be older than 21, rather than 21 or older, to rent a car. This misconception often arises from confusion between the 'greater than' (>) and 'greater than or equal to' (>=) operators. Using this distractor would incorrectly prevent 21-year-olds from renting a car, as the condition would only be true for those aged 22 and above. This error highlights the importance of understanding the subtle differences between comparison operators.

distractors.description: Podria escoger esta linea si aplica incorrectamente el operador logico NOT, pensando que debe usarse para verificar una condicion positiva. Este distractor resultaria en una situacion donde solo los conductores sin licencia de 21 anos o mas podrian alquilar un auto, que es lo contrario de la logica intencionada. Este error subraya una incomprension comun sobre como funciona la negacion en expresiones logicas. Es importante asegurar que las condiciones se expresen de forma positiva cuando se verifican requisitos como tener licencia.
distractors.untr_description: You might choose this line if you incorrectly apply the logical NOT operator, thinking it should be used to check for a positive condition. This distractor would result in a situation where only unlicensed drivers aged 21 or older could rent a car, which is the opposite of the intended logic. This error highlights a common misunderstanding of how negation works in logical expressions. It's important to ensure that conditions are expressed positively when checking for requirements like having a license.
